versions.subject: Added Atomic Blue Detections Repo
versions.detection:
selection1:
    Image: '*\reg.exe'
    CommandLine: 
        - '* save *'
        - '* export *'
selection2:
    CommandLine:
        - '*hklm*'
        - '*hkey_local_machine*'
selection3:
    CommandLine:
        - '*\\sam *'
        - '*\\security *'
        - '*\\system *'
condition: selection1 and selection2 and selection3
versions.spl: Image="*\\reg.exe" CommandLine IN ("* save *", "* export *") CommandLine IN ("*hklm*", "*hkey_local_machine*") CommandLine IN ("*\\sam *", "*\\security *", "*\\system *")
